about: Target crate and module for every module of crates/gents/src. A rule names a module by its source path (without .rs; a directory and its .rs or mod.rs are one module) and applies to that module and everything declared under it, until a deeper rule says otherwise. Crates are listed bottom to top; a crate may depend only on crates before it.
